building_composition.source: Locked by discussion-notes.md Topic 3 (Air & Space Forces Magazine, Air Force magazine of record). Three 2-story buildings are: #11 Chapel, #12 Granite Inn, #13 Medical/Dental.

chamber_array.form: Single rectangular chamber with 15 free-standing buildings arranged in a 5x3 grid. Real complex has 3 parallel main tunnels intersected by 4 cross tunnels; in compressed scale this is rendered as one larger unified chamber.
chamber_array.ceiling: Bare pink granite with rock bolts. One or more 6x6 light gray concrete dome patches (1962 fault repair).
chamber_array.floor: Light gray concrete (polished andesite) main, iron trapdoors for service paths, black concrete for spring-display areas under each building.
signage: 1,319 SPRINGS - 1,000 LB EACH - INSTALLED 1964 - NEVER REPLACED
NORMAL SHOCK: 1 INCH BUILDING MOVEMENT. EXTREME EVENT: 12 INCHES.
MAIN CHAMBER - 4.5 ACRES (1967) - 3 MAIN TUNNELS x 4 CROSS TUNNELS
APRIL 20, 1966 - COMBAT OPERATIONS CENTER DECLARED OPERATIONAL (SECONDARY)
OPERATIONS CENTER INTERIORS - These rooms are designer interpretations based on declassified public information, 2006-2016 public photographs, and the 1978 GAO report on the five operating centers.

easter_eggs.name: 1980 False Alarm Plaque
easter_eggs.location_in_building: back wall to the right of entrance door
easter_eggs.text: JUNE 3, 1980. A 46-CENT COMPUTER CHIP FAILED IN THE MISSILE WARNING NETWORK. NORAD BRIEFLY REPORTED 2,200 SOVIET ICBMs INBOUND. BOMBER CREWS TOOK THEIR STATIONS. NATIONAL SECURITY ADVISOR ZBIGNIEW BRZEZINSKI WAS WOKEN AT 3:00 A.M. HE DID NOT WAKE HIS WIFE, CALCULATING SHE HAD MINUTES TO LIVE. THE ALERT WAS RESOLVED WHEN A THIRD CALL REPORTED NO RADAR OR SATELLITE CONFIRMATION. 'GOING TO WAR. AND IT CAME DAMN CLOSE TO TAKING THE COUNTRY WITH IT.' - OFFICE OF TECHNOLOGY ASSESSMENT
